name: Do you offer cabinet refacing as an alternative to full replacement in the San Francisco Peninsula area?

mainEntity.name: Do you offer cabinet refacing as an alternative to full replacement in the San Francisco Peninsula area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, cabinet refacing is an excellent alternative to full replacement when the existing cabinet boxes are structurally sound. This process involves replacing cabinet doors and drawer fronts and applying a new veneer to the existing cabinet frames, giving your kitchen a completely refreshed look at a lower cost and with less disruption than a full remodel. We offer refacing services across our service areas, including cities on the San Francisco Peninsula such as San Bruno, Millbrae, and Burlingame. It's an efficient way to update your kitchen's aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we offer cabinet refacing in the San Francisco Peninsula area as a cost-effective alternative to full replacement. It updates your kitchen's look by replacing doors/drawer fronts and veneering existing frames.
